title: regional-reorder-priority-matrix (WIP)
content:
Purpose:
This is a working reorder-priority matrix and short procurement timeline for the GPU fleet. Focus is on minimizing stockouts across NA/EU/APAC while balancing lead-time risk and unit cost. NOT final — for planning sync 2026-02-25.

Assumptions (high level):
- Forecast horizon: 6 months (Mar–Aug 2026) using current usage curve + 20% growth for new customers.
- Safety buffer target: 14 days of peak-request tokens converted to GPU-hours; regionally applied.
- Vendors: VendorA (preferred, longer lead times but bulk pricing), VendorB (shorter lead times, limited supply), CloudSpot (on-demand rush fulfillment).

Quick summary recommendations (top-line):
1) Place a small immediate top-up order (VendorB) for 80 A100-80GBs into EU region to cover Q2 spikes — ARRIVE estimated mid-Apr 2026. Priority lane: medium-high.
2) Initiate VendorA 3-tranche order for NA and APAC for Q3 (A100+H100 mixed) with staggered shipments (Jun/Jul/Aug) to smooth lead-time variance. Priority lane: high for NA, medium for APAC.
3) Maintain a CloudSpot contingency budget for on-demand provisioning up to 5% of fleet for emergency bursts.

Lead-time notes and variability:
- VendorA lead times vary with SKU and region: baseline 70–110 days; large bulk orders push to 120+.
- VendorB can do 30–50 days for standard SKUs but caps per-month volume; good for topping off.
- Sea freight to APAC adds ~14 days to ETA vs air; customs windows (EU) add unpredictable +7–14 days.

Procurement pipeline (draft schedule):
- Now (Feb 2026): finalize EU urgent small order (VendorB) for 80 A100s. Owner: Ethan. PO due: 2026-02-26.
- Mar 2026: commit tranche 1 to VendorA for NA (100 A100 + 40 H100). Finance approval needed. Owner: Priya. PO due: 2026-03-10.
- Apr 2026: confirm cloud contingency budget (ops finance) and test CloudSpot playbook. Owner: Maya.
- May 2026: tranche 2 to VendorA for APAC (50 A100 + 60 H100). PO due: 2026-05-15.
- Jun–Aug 2026: expected arrivals and integration; confirm racks, power, and SRE readiness 6 weeks before ETA.

Risk matrix (short):
- Lead-time blowout (vendor/ship): high impact, medium probability -> Mitigation: staggered orders + cloud contingency.
- Customs holdups (EU/APAC): medium impact, medium probability -> Mitigation: route some shipments via different ports; pre-clear docs.
- SKU shortage (H100 ramp): high impact, high probability -> Mitigation: convert some H100 demand to A100 (software quantization guidance), early vendor commitments.

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Can finance approve 3-tranche VendorA commit by 2026-03-01? (INFRA-622)
- Is there appetite to increase CloudSpot contingency spend from $150k to $250k this quarter? (Ops + Finance)
- Confirm whether APAC team can accept longer lead times or if we need to front-load NA and route capacity via inter-region burst routing.

Action items (owner + ETA):
- Ethan: finalize EU VendorB PO + shipping incoterms by 2026-02-26.
- Priya: prepare cost comparison (VendorA vs VendorB) including duty/tax scenarios by 2026-02-28.
- Maya: update deployment runbook for staged arrival and notify SRE for install windows by 2026-03-05.
- Liam: simulate 14-day outage of incoming shipments and run capacity fallback test in staging by 2026-03-12.

Notes to self / working thoughts:
- Might be worth negotiating an option clause with VendorA to convert up to 20% of A100s to H100 at time of final tranche confirmation (reduces mismatch risk).
- Check if any reserved-capacity customers have contractual clauses requiring specific SKUs — flag to SEs.
- Cross-check with infra-inventory sheet: if on-hand NA A100 drops below 180 after shipments are reallocated, trigger emergency CloudSpot order.
